description: This Java class is a command handler for approving loan reschedule requests within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses Spring annotations for service and transaction management, and invokes the LoanRescheduleRequestWritePlatformService to perform the approval operation.

classes.name: ApproveLoanRescheduleRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles approval commands for loan reschedule requests in the Fineract loan portfolio module.

methods.name: ApproveLoanRescheduleRequestCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the LoanRescheduleRequestWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to approve a loan reschedule request by delegating to the service layer.
